metadata.description: Vocabulary review file - all words preserved for manual curation
metadata.note: Every word preserved - nothing automatically rejected. Status field for manual curation.

workflow: Set status to 'canonical' for worship vocabulary words
Set status to 'reject' for non-worship words
Set status to 'grammatical' for grammatical forms (to be handled in morphology layer)
Do NOT delete entries - all words must have a status

statusValues.canonical: Canonical worship vocabulary word - include in dictionary
statusValues.reject: Not a worship word - exclude from dictionary
statusValues.grammatical: Grammatical form - exclude from dictionary (morphology layer)
statusValues.variant: Variant spelling of canonical word - add to variants array
